title: Exercise Tarang Shakti: A Mirror to India’s Multipronged Engagements
gist: Exercise Tarang Shakti 2026 in Jodhpur featured a formation of Indian, US, French and UAE aircraft alongside a Russian-origin Su-30MKI, which the author reads as evidence of India's multi-pronged defense engagement. The excerpt is truncated.

insights.claim: India's Defense Minister Rajnath Singh said on October 10 that future defense relationships will be about technology and trust, not just platforms.
insights.speaker: Dinakar Peri
insights.so_what: Indian procurement is shifting toward tech-transfer and trust-based partnerships.
insights.quote: The defense relationships of the future will be about technology and trust, not just about platforms,

insights.claim: A fly-past at Tarang Shakti put a Russian-origin Su-30MKI at the center, flanked by a US F-35, an Indian LCA, a French Rafale and a UAE F-16, which the author calls testimony to India's multi-pronged foreign policy.
insights.speaker: Dinakar Peri
insights.so_what: India continues to buy and exercise across Russian, US and French suppliers, which matters for defense order flow.
